description: This header file declares internal functions related to the Zigbee subsystem within the Zilker SDK. It includes function prototypes for device discovery, attribute report handling, device management, firmware updates, and network reconfiguration, primarily used internally by the event handler.

methods.name: zigbeeSubsystemDeviceDiscovered
methods.description: Handles a discovered Zigbee device, passing device details.

methods.name: zigbeeSubsystemAttributeReportReceived
methods.description: Processes an attribute report received from a Zigbee device.

methods.name: zigbeeSubsystemClusterCommandReceived
methods.description: Handles reception of a cluster command from a Zigbee device.

methods.name: zigbeeSubsystemDeviceLeft
methods.description: Handles a device leaving the Zigbee network identified by its EUI64.

methods.name: zigbeeSubsystemDeviceRejoined
methods.description: Handles a device rejoining the network, with security status.

methods.name: zigbeeSubsystemLinkKeyUpdated
methods.description: Updates handling when a link key is updated for a device.

methods.name: zigbeeSubsystemDeviceFirmwareUpgrading
methods.description: Indicates firmware upgrade has started for a device.

methods.name: zigbeeSubsystemDeviceFirmwareVersionNotify
methods.description: Notifies current firmware version of a device.

methods.name: zigbeeSubsystemReconfigureNetwork
methods.description: Reconfigures the Zigbee network with specific parameters.

methods.name: zigbeeSubsystemClaimDiscoveredDevice
methods.description: Attempts to claim/discover a device for migration purposes.

methods.name: zigbeeSubsystemAddPrematureClusterCommand
methods.description: Adds a cluster command prematurely to the internal queue.
